burden.line: And the freedom they take is the earthly burden
stanza: Oh, giver of empathy
It is a gift so bitter that you brought to me
'Cause I feel what they're feeling and I know that they're free
And the freedom they take is the earthly burden

burden.songTitle: One Sunday Morning (Song for Jane Smiley’s Boyfriend)
burden.line: I fell in love with the burden
stanza: Something sad keeps moving
So I wandered around
I fell in love with the burden
Holding me down
Finally, gone is the burden
Of the Crowley way of bein'
That comes from energies combined
Like my part was, I was not discernin'
And you, as we found out
Were not in your right mind

burden.songTitle: We’ve Come Too Far to Turn Around
stanza: We've been victims of his wrath
We've wavered from the path
But we have come to far to turn around
We will lay down burden
Of hate and separation
'Cause we have come to far to turn around
For over four hundred years
We've been on this trail of tears
We have come to far to turn around
He told me sweet lies of sweet loves
Heavy with the burden of the truth
And he spoke of his dreams
Broken by the burden
Broken by the burden of his youth
Slowed my pace down
Somatic burden
I see a wide sphere
A table, I thought
